chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Musanna ibn al-Walid, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) prayed seventy prayers upon Hamza.
ai.seo_question: How many prayers did the Prophet perform upon Hamza?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the unique ritual of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) performing seventy individual prayers (Salat) upon Hamza ibn Abd al-Muttalib, distinguishing it from the standard four Takbeers in the funeral prayer. Shia scholars, such as Al-Sharif al-Murtada, discuss whether this was a specific honor for Hamza or a general practice, emphasizing the spiritual merit accorded to the martyrs of the Battle of Uhud. The hadith underscores the significance of intercessory prayer for the deceased within the broader context of Shia jurisprudence and devotional practices.
